description: This file defines the MediaFrameWriterV1 class, which implements the IMediaFrameWriter interface for writing media frames to shared memory. It includes class members, methods for writing frame data, and metadata handling, along with constants for versioning and encryption metadata size.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames and associated metadata into shared memory, implementing the IMediaFrameWriter interface.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the shared memory buffer and info.

methods.description: Writes a media segment frame into shared memory.

methods.description: Returns the number of frames written so far.
